'''Teacher''' (Japanese: '''保母''' ''Kindergarten Teacher'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP121|The Lonely Snover!]]''.

She appeared at the end of the episode with the kindergarten children that she teaches. She informed {{an|Dawn}} that the next [[Pokémon Contest]] venue will be held in [[Sandalstraw Town]].
